name: jungle-rider
description: Jungle Rider - a lightweight 3D bike racing game for Android built with Three.js, Vite and Capacitor.

scripts.verify: npm run smoke && npm run build && npm run size
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
